turnout.note: Near-final: people already in line at 22:00 could still vote. Highest at that hour since 1999 (70.6% in 2022).

source.name: Times of Israel, from the Central Elections Committee

reactions.speaker: Benjamin Netanyahu
reactions.quote: The Likud is the biggest party in Israel. The right-wing bloc has a decisive majority. We are still waiting for the true results.

reactions.speaker: Gadi Eisenkot
reactions.quote: If these are the final results, this is a victory for Israel's responsible Zionist majority.

reactions.speaker: Aryeh Deri
reactions.paraphrase: said to wait for the real results.

reactions.speaker: Itamar Ben Gvir
reactions.paraphrase: said a unity government with Eisenkot would be a mistake.

reactions.speaker: Yair Lapid
reactions.quote: Don't let them confuse you: The Netanyahu bloc suffered a harsh defeat.

reactions.speaker: Naftali Bennett
reactions.paraphrase: said Netanyahu had lost, that the bloc's leaders were talking and coordinating, and that he would wait patiently for the real results.

reactions.speaker: Yair Golan
reactions.quote: The public has spoken, it has fired the Netanyahu government.

reactions.speaker: Avigdor Liberman
reactions.paraphrase: said soldiers' votes could lift Yisrael Beiteinu well above its exit-poll figure, and expects clearer results by Friday.

reactions.speaker: Mansour Abbas
reactions.quote: We'll translate this electoral power into an influential political force.
